etymology: middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred [middle voice] eleuyomai eleuthomai el-yoo'-thom-ahee, or [active] elyw eltho el'-tho, which do not otherwise occur)
definition:
1) to come
   1a) of persons
       1a1) to come from one place to another, and used both of
            persons arriving and of those returning
       1a2) to appear, make one's appearance, come before the public
 2) metaph.
   2a) to come into being, arise, come forth, show itself, find
       place or influence
   2b) be established, become known, to come (fall) into or unto
 3) to go, to follow one

 Sinonim   : Lihat Definisi 5818
